title: 第十一章 这可是好东西啊第十二章 不听话怎么行
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
值守弟子的眼睛瞪大，难以置信的看着面前发生的的场景。
刚才测灵根什么都没能测出来的老太太，轻轻轻轻将储物袋里的东西掏出来了？
难道真的是这块石头出问题了？可他刚才用挺正常的啊。
叶晚秋提这一袋面，对于这个储物袋的功能还是觉得新奇。
这么小的一个袋子，是怎么装得下这么大袋的面粉，拿着还是轻巧的？
而且这里面不只是一袋面粉，还有其他东西呢。
修仙界果然不一样。
“对了小伙子，怎么把这东西再放进去啊？”
值守弟子连忙回神，“就是你心里想着，要把东西放进去，它就……就是这样。”
叶晚秋看着空空的手，依旧觉得不可思议，这么就没了？
反反复复几次，叶晚秋熟练掌握了储物袋的使用方法。
她将几个储物袋收好，再次对值守弟子表示感激，“谢谢你了小伙子，我先走了，咱们下个月再见！”
值守弟子呆在原地，之前还纳闷这人什么都不知道就被带进门派了，但是经过刚才这一出，他反应过来，游星师姐那么厉害的人带回门派的人怎么可能是普通人。
就是年纪的大了一点，恐怕这辈子最多也就是个外门弟子了。
值守弟子摇摇头，坐回原来的位置继续打盹。
叶晚秋带着储物袋回到了院子，将里面的东西一一拿出来。
果然和想象中差不多，杂役弟子的储物袋里是最普通的米面粮油，而游星她们内门弟子的资源就好上许多了，还有各种类型的蔬菜和肉呢。
不过每个人储物袋里的肉类都是不一样的，将四个储物袋里的东西都拿出来之后，叶晚秋收获了一头猪，半扇羊，还有五只鸡。
他们五个人吃一个月的话，足够了。
叶晚秋将这些东西简单分类了一下，肉类放在一个储物袋里，米面放在另一个储物袋里。

这样不用担心放在厨房里会生虫，拿出来也不费事。
最后就是所谓的灵石。
杂役弟子有两枚，鸡蛋般大小，散发着微微的光，像是……
叶晚秋想了想，得出结论，像是荧光石。
内门弟子的储物袋里有五枚，当然，颜色也更亮一些。
她不知道这东西怎么用，好像只有修炼才能用得到，干脆摆在床头的位置，就当做是个小夜灯了。
时间还早，叶晚秋打算出去转悠转悠。
她现在可是有地图的人，应该不会再迷路了……吧？
叶晚秋看着地图，出了院门之后，一边通向菜园子，另一边是杂役弟子的区域，那她换个方向转转。
她走进院子后面的林子，砍了一根小竹子，努力给自己编了个小菜篮。
儿子女儿上学时有不少的手工课，那老头子根本就不在意孩子的事情，每个月给那么几千块钱就做甩手掌柜。
为了不让儿子女儿因为这些手工课伤心，叶晚秋买了本书，上面有不少东西最基础的做法。
没想到她的记忆力还不错，这么多年没做了还能编出来个形状。
再用较细的枝条继续编，很快，一个竹篮便完成了。
叶晚秋拿起仔细看了看，虽然是粗糙了一点，但是装东西没问题，还是挺结实的。
content_en:
The disciples on duty widened their eyes and looked at the scene happening in front of them in disbelief.
The old lady who just couldn't detect anything through her spiritual root test gently took out the contents of her storage bag?
Is there really something wrong with this stone? But what he used just now was quite normal.
When Ye Wanqiu mentioned this bag of noodles, he was still curious about the function of this storage bag.
How can such a small bag hold such a large bag of flour and still be light and easy to hold?
And it’s not just a bag of flour, there’s other stuff.
The world of cultivating immortals is indeed different.
"By the way, young man, how do you put this thing in again?"
The disciple on duty quickly came to his senses, "You just think in your mind that you want to put something in, and it just...is like this."
Ye Wanqiu looked at his empty hands, still feeling incredible, it was gone like this?
After repeating it several times, Ye Wanqiu mastered the use of storage bags.
She put away several storage bags and once again expressed her gratitude to the disciple on duty, "Thank you, young man, I'll leave first. See you next month!"
The disciple on duty stayed where he was, wondering before that this person was brought into the sect without knowing anything, but after what happened just now, he realized how could someone as powerful as Senior Sister Yuxing bring someone into the sect to be an ordinary person.
Even though he is a little older, I am afraid he will only be an outer disciple at best in this life.
The disciple on duty shook his head, sat back to his original position and continued to take a nap.
Ye Wanqiu returned to the yard with the storage bag and took out the contents one by one.
As expected, it was almost as expected. The storage bags of the handyman disciples contained the most common rice, flour, grains and oils, but the resources of Yu Xing and the other inner disciples were much better, as well as various types of vegetables and meat.
However, the meat in everyone's storage bags is different. After taking out the contents of the four storage bags, Ye Wanqiu harvested a pig, half a sheep, and five chickens.
It would be enough for the five of them to eat for a month.
Ye Wanqiu briefly classified these things, putting meat in one storage bag and rice and noodles in another storage bag.
This way you don’t have to worry about pests getting in the kitchen, and it doesn’t take much trouble to take it out.
Finally, there is the so-called spiritual stone.
There are two handyman disciples, the size of eggs, emitting a faint light, like...
Ye Wanqiu thought for a while and came to the conclusion that it was like a fluorescent stone.
There are five of them in the inner disciple's storage bag. Of course, the color is brighter.
She didn't know how to use this thing. It seemed that it could only be used by practicing, so she simply placed it on the bedside and used it as a night light.
It was still early, and Ye Wanqiu planned to go out and wander around.
She has a map now, so she shouldn't get lost again...right?
Ye Wanqiu looked at the map. After leaving the courtyard gate, one side led to the vegetable garden, and the other side was the area for the handyman disciples, so she changed directions.
She walked into the forest behind the yard, cut down a small bamboo, and worked hard to weave a small vegetable basket for herself.
My son and daughter had a lot of handicraft classes when they were in school, but the old man didn't care about his children's affairs at all. He paid thousands of dollars every month and became a hands-on shopkeeper.
In order to prevent his son and daughter from being sad because of these handicraft classes, Ye Wanqiu bought a book, which contains many basic methods.
I didn’t expect that her memory was pretty good and she could still make up a shape after not doing it for so many years.
Then continue weaving with thinner branches, and soon, a bamboo basket is completed.
Ye Wanqiu picked it up and looked at it carefully. Although it was a little rough, there was no problem in holding it. It was still quite strong.
